Act 1 & 2: You think everyone has gone mad—except you!

That missing engineer clearly took his own life, and the rest is just a horrifying shared hallucination, a side effect of DeKompress.

You have 10 doses of X-Stims with you.

Your goal is to administer a dose to everyone, whether they want it or not, to calm them down and make them realize they are experiencing a mass hallucination!

You show no symptoms yourself and must not use the drug on yourself. Its side effects might hinder your ability to act and save others.
